weapon.d: If foe initiates combat or if foe's HP ≥ 75% at start of combat, grants Atk+5 to unit, inflicts Atk-5 on foe, and inflicts Special cooldown charge -1 on foe per attack during combat. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)

If foe initiates combat or if foe's HP ≥ 75% at start of combat, grants Atk+5 to unit, inflicts Atk-5 on foe, and inflicts Special cooldown charge -1 on foe per attack during combat. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)

assist.d:
Restores 10 HP to target ally.
Unit loses 10 HP but cannot go below 1.

a.d: If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Res+X to unit during combat (X = number of allies within 2 spaces; max 3).
If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Res+X to unit during combat (X = number of allies within 2 spaces + 2; max 5).
If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Res+X to unit during combat (X = 2 × number of allies within 2 spaces, + 1; max 7).

b.d: At start of turn, if any foe's Res ≤ unit's Res-3 and that foe is adjacent to another foe, inflicts Res-3 on that foe through its next action.
At start of turn, if any foe's Res ≤ unit's Res-3 and that foe is adjacent to another foe, inflicts Res-5 on that foe through its next action.
At start of turn, if any foe's Res ≤ unit's Res-3 and that foe is adjacent to another foe, inflicts Res-7 on that foe through its next action.
